intended_object: The standard contravariant equivalence between closed subschemes of a scheme X (closed immersions into X, as a full subcategory of Over X) and the lattice of quasi-coherent ideal sheaves on X (from docstring and name).
explanation: The definition builds an equivalence (Over_{closed immersion} X)ᵒᵖ ≌ X.IdealSheafData for an arbitrary scheme X. The functor takes the kernel ideal sheaf. The inverse sends I to the closed subscheme I.subschemeι. The unit uses the isomorphism of a closed immersion onto its scheme-theoretic image, and the counit is the equality ker(subschemeι I) = I. Morphisms in MorphismProperty.Over P ⊤ X are all morphisms over X; between closed immersions these are unique if they exist, so the category is the poset of closed subschemes. This is exactly the classical correspondence, stated in full generality.
